result.topic_en: Riemann proves via a uniqueness theorem that two solutions agreeing with their normal derivatives along a line must coincide, and states Theorem III: the points where a harmonic function u takes a given value form lines separating regions where u is larger from regions where it is smaller; a column of numbers is added in the margin.
result.transcription:

III Die Punkte im Innern von $T$, wo $u$ einen
constanten Werth hat, bilden, wenn $u$ nicht über-
all constant ist, nothwendig Linien, welche Flächen-

$u$ kann nicht in einem Punkte im Innern von

items.english: III. The points in the interior of T where u has a constant value necessarily form, if u is not constant everywhere, lines which separate surface parts where u is greater from surface parts where u is smaller.
